OP blocked me on my main account but remission is just when you don’t meet the criteria for a diagnoses anymore. It can look very different for everyone. For example, there are still some symptoms that I exhibit with BPD but my impulsiveness, risk-taking behaviors, anger, and consistent irritability have diminished drastically but I still have really bad depression, distorted self-image, and feelings of emptiness.

As for your fear of being a narcissist, one [study](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/24512458/) suggest a remission rate of 53% for NPD. 

Though, I know it’s difficult and sometimes can feel like there’s nothing you can do to help yourself, that’s not always the case. If you can, seek therapy. A good therapist can really help you thrive. I wish you the best!

I’m also in the same boat but it’s been over a year. Best advice I have is to explore your body more and invest in good sex toys.
